G3588.b:
⟪ὁ⟫, ἡ, τό, the prepositive article (ἄρθρον προτακτικόν), originally a demonstr. pron. (so usually in Hom.), in general corresponding to the Eng. definite article.
⟪I.⟫ As demonstr. pron.
	⟪1.⟫ As freq. in Hom., absol., ⟪he⟫ (⟪she⟫, ⟪it⟫), ⟪his⟫ (etc.): ⟦Acts 17:28|Ac 17:28⟧ (quoted from the poet Aratus).
	⟪2.⟫ Distributive, ὁ μὲν . . . ὁ δέ, ⟪the one . . . the other⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 7:7|I Co 7:7⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:22|Ga 4:22⟧; pl., ⟦Acts 14:4|Ac 14:4⟧, ⟦Acts 17:32|17:32⟧, ⟦Philippians 1:16|Phl 1:16⟧, al.; οἱ μὲν . . . ἄλλοι δέ, ⟦Matthew 16:14|Mt 16:14⟧, ⟦John 7:12|Jo 7:12⟧; οἱ μεν̀ . . . ὁ δέ, ⟦Hebrews 7:21|He 7:21⟧, ⟦Hebrews 7:23|23⟧.
	⟪3.⟫ In narration (without ὁ μὲν preceding), ὁ δέ, ⟪but he⟫: ⟦Matthew 2:14|Mt 2:14⟧, ⟦Mark 1:45|Mk 1:45⟧, ⟦Luke 8:21|Lk 8:21⟧, ⟦John 9:38|Jo 9:38⟧, al. mult.
⟪II.⟫ As prepositive article, ⟪the⟫, prefixed,
	⟪1.⟫ to nouns unmodified: ὁ θεός, τὸ φῶς, etc.; to abstract nouns, ἡ σοφία, etc., to pl. nouns which indicate a class, οἱ ἀλώπεκες, ⟪foxes⟫, ⟦Matthew 8:20|Mt 8:20⟧, al.; to an individual as representing a class, ὁ ἐργάτης, ⟦Luke 10:7|Lk 10:7⟧; c. nom. = voc. in addresses, ⟦Matthew 11:26|Mt 11:26⟧, ⟦John 19:3|Jo 19:3⟧, ⟦James 5:1|Ja 5:1⟧, al.; to things which pertain to one, ἡ χεῖρ, ⟪his hand⟫, ⟦Mark 3:1|Mk 3:1⟧; to names of persons well known or already mentioned; usually to names of countries (originally adjectives), ἡ Ἰουδαία, etc.
	⟪2.⟫ To modified nouns: c. pers. pron. gen., μοῦ, σοῦ, etc.; c. poss. pron., ἐμός, σός, etc.; c. adj. between the art. and the noun, ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος, ⟦Matthew 12:35|Mt 12:35⟧; the noun foll. by adj., both c. art., ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, ⟦John 10:11|Jo 10:11⟧ (on ὁ ὄχλος πολύς, ⟦John 12:9|Jo 12:9⟧, v. M, Pr., 84); before adjectival phrases, ἡ κατ’ ἐκλογὴν πρόθεσις, ⟦Romans 9:11|Ro 9:11⟧.
	⟪3.⟫ To Other parts of speech used as substantives;
		⟪(a)⟫ neuter adjectives: τ. ἀγαθόν, etc.;
		⟪(b)⟫ cardinal numerals: ὁ εἶς, οἷ δύο, etc.;
		⟪(c)⟫ participles: ὁ βαπτίζων (= ὁ Βαπτιστής, ⟦Matthew 14:2|Mt 14:2⟧), ⟦Mark 6:14|Mk 6:14⟧; πᾶς ὁ, c. ptcp., ⟪every one who⟫, etc.;
		⟪(d)⟫ adverbs: τὸ πέραν, τὰ νῦν, ὁ ἔσω ἄνθρωπος;
		⟪(e)⟫ infinitives: nom., τὸ θέλειν, ⟦Romans 7:18|Ro 7:18⟧, al.; gen., τοῦ, after adjectives, ἄξιον τοῦ πορεύεσθαι, ⟦1 Corinthians 16:4|I Co 16:4⟧; verbs, ἔλαχεν τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι, ⟦Luke 1:9|Lk 1:9⟧; and freq. in a final sense, ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρειν, ⟦Matthew 13:3|Mt 13:3⟧ (on the artic. inf., v. Bl., § 71).
	⟪4.⟫ In the neut. to sentences, phrases or single words treated as a quotation: τὸ Ἐι δύνῃ, ⟦Mark 9:23|Mk 9:23⟧; τὸ ἔτι ἅπαξ, ⟦Hebrews 12:27|He 12:27⟧; τὸ ἀνέβη, ⟦Ephesians 4:9|Eph 4:9⟧, al.
	⟪5.⟫ To prepositional phrases: οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας, ⟦Hebrews 13:24|He 13:24⟧; οἱ ἐκ νόμου, ⟦Romans 4:14|Ro 4:14⟧; neut. acc. absol., in adverbial phrases, τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν, ⟪daily⟫, ⟦Luke 11:3|Lk 11:3⟧; τὸ κατὰ σάρκα, ⟪as regards the flesh⟫, ⟦Romans 9:5|Ro 9:5⟧.
	⟪6.⟫ To nouns in the genitive, denoting kinship, association, etc.: ὁ τοῦ, ⟪the son of⟫ (unless context indicates a different relationship), ⟦Matthew 10:2|Mt 10:2⟧, al.; τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, ⟪the things that pertain to God⟫, ⟦Matthew 16:23|Mt 16:23⟧; τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης, ⟦Romans 14:19|Ro 14:19⟧ (cf. M, Pr., 81 ff.; Bl, §§ 46, 47).
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

(obj.), ἐθνῶν, ⟦Matthew 10:5|Mt 10:5⟧; τ. ἁγίων (fig.), ⟦Hebrews 9:8|He 9:8⟧; acc., ὁδόν, with force of prep. (like Heb. ⁨דֶּרֶךְ⁩; Bl., § 34, 8; 35, 5), ὁ. θαλάσσης, ⟦Matthew 4:15|Mt 4:15⟧(LXX).
